summary_1line: Explorer Robert Walton writes to his sister from St. Petersburg, describing his ambitious plan to reach the North Pole and his lifelong dream of discovery.

image_candidates.scene_text: Robert Walton walks through the snowy streets of St. Petersburg as a cold northern wind blows against his face while he dreams of the polar seas.
A lone explorer stands on a ship’s deck in icy northern waters, gazing toward a glowing horizon of endless polar light.
Walton studies maps and navigation instruments by lamplight, preparing for a dangerous voyage to the North Pole.
